item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 18/Feb/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong in the next few days. It will be windy with cool mornings over the region. A band of clouds will cover the region midweek this week. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China on Sunday. The weather will be rather cool over the region early next week.
